name: PathVQA
intro: PathVQA 是病理图像视觉问答基准，包含 4,998 张图像和 32,799 个问答，其中 16,465 个为开放式、16,334 个为是非题；数据由病理学教材和 PEIR 资源经半自动生成与逐题人工校验构建。
org: University of California, San Diego; Beijing University of Technology; Carnegie Mellon University
build_method: 教材与PEIR图文抽取, CoreNLP与Tregex问答生成, 全量人工校验
metric: Accuracy, Exact Match, Macro F1, BLEU-1/2/3
eval_feature: 7类问题, 开放式与是非题平衡, 图像级划分, 多指标评测
build_method_en: Textbook and PEIR image-caption extraction, CoreNLP and Tregex QA generation, full manual verification
eval_feature_en: Seven question types, balanced open-ended and yes/no questions, image-level splits, multiple evaluation metrics
intro_en: PathVQA is a pathology visual question-answering benchmark with 4,998 images and 32,799 QA pairs: 16,465 open-ended and 16,334 yes/no. It is built from pathology textbooks and PEIR through semi-automatic generation followed by manual verification of every question.
scale_en: 32,799 QA pairs, 4,998 images, seven question types
metric_en: Accuracy, Exact Match, Macro F1, BLEU-1/2/3
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2003.10286 and the official UCSD-AI4H repository. The pipeline extracts 1,670 textbook images with PyPDF2/PDFMiner and 3,328 PEIR images with Requests/BeautifulSoup, then removes non-pathology images and repairs mismatches. Stanford CoreNLP and Tregex generate seven open question types; yes/no questions are created by inversion and same-POS negative substitution. Every QA pair is manually proofread for spelling, syntax, semantics, ambiguity, and artifacts. The final image-level split is 2,499/17,325 train, 1,499/9,462 validation, and 1,000/6,012 test images/QAs; yes/no uses accuracy and open-ended answers use exact match, macro F1, and BLEU-1/2/3.
